description: This file defines the PersistentStateFactory class responsible for creating instances of IPersistentState for grains, along with the internal PersistentState class that manages the lifecycle and state loading of persistent grain state in Orleans.

classes.name: PersistentStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating persistent state instances for grains.

classes.name: PersistentState
classes.description: Internal class managing the persistent state lifecycle and state loading for grains.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new persistent state instance for a grain based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: GetFullStateName
methods.description: Returns the full state name, defaulting to the configured state name.

methods.name: ThrowMissingProviderException
methods.description: Throws an exception if no storage provider is found for the grain.

methods.name: PersistentState
methods.description: Constructor for initializing persistent state and subscribing to lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the start lifecycle event, loading state if not already loaded.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stop lifecycle event, currently a no-op.
